summary.whatChanges: Renames zod v4 core's exported `process` JSON Schema helper to `processSchema` across the to-json-schema modules, keeping `process` as a deprecated export alias (which declares no module-scope binding), and adds an esbuild-based test that bundles classic and mini entrypoints alongside injected node-global polyfills.
behaviorChanges: Bundles that reach `toJSONSchema` no longer emit a module-scope `const/function process` declaration, so banner-injected `process` polyfills no longer cause a duplicate-declaration parse error
`z.core.processSchema` is now the primary export name for the JSON Schema processing helper
`z.core.process` still resolves, now as a deprecated alias to `processSchema`
New test suite bundles the classic and mini entrypoints with esbuild and re-parses the output to detect symbol collisions
risks: The deprecated `process` alias keeps the old export name in the public surface; consumers re-exporting it under a lexical binding could reintroduce the collision
The new test adds an esbuild build dependency and a 30s timeout, which may be slow or flaky in CI
The patch is truncated, so remaining `process(` call sites in json-schema-processors.ts cannot be confirmed renamed
`JSONSchemaGenerator.process` method name is unchanged, so naming is now inconsistent between the class method and the free function
